# allformatter.com

> A fast, secure, client-side JSON formatting and developer utility tool.

## About
allformatter.com provides developers with completely free and private tools to manipulate, format, and convert data. All operations happen client-side in the browser.

## Features & Tools

**JSON Tools**
- **JSON Beautifier** (/): Format, minify, and validate JSON data.
- **JSON Compare** (/json-compare): Visually diff two JSON objects.
- **JSON to XML** (/json-to-xml): Convert JSON strings to XML format.
- **JSON to CSV** (/tools/json-to-csv): Export JSON arrays as CSV files.
- **CSV to JSON** (/tools/csv-to-json): Import CSV and convert to JSON.
- **JSON Schema Validator** (/tools/json-schema-validator): Validate JSON against a schema.

**HTML & CSS Tools**
- **HTML Beautifier** (/html-beautifier): Clean and indent HTML.
- **CSS Minifier** (/tools/css-minifier): Compress CSS code.
- **CSS Gradient Generator** (/tools/css-gradient-generator): Build beautiful CSS gradients.
- **HTML to JSX** (/tools/html-to-jsx): Convert HTML into React JSX.
- **HTML Entity Encoder** (/tools/html-entity-encoder): Encode/decode HTML entities.

**Encoding & Decoding**
- **Base64 to PDF** (/tools/base64-to-pdf): Decode Base64 strings into PDF documents.
- **Base64 Encode/Decode** (/tools/base64-encode-decode): Encode or decode standard strings.
- **URL Encode/Decode** (/tools/url-encode-decode): Safely encode or decode URLs.
- **Hash Generator** (/tools/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, and other hashes.

**Developer Utilities**
- **Cron Parser** (/tools/cron-parser): Parse and explain cron expressions in human language.
- **Password Generator** (/tools/password-generator): Generate secure, random passwords.
- **Git Command Generator** (/tools/git-command-generator): Build complex git commands.
- **HTTP Status Codes** (/tools/http-status-codes): Reference lookup for HTTP status codes.

## Technical Details
- Architecture: Next.js App Router, React, Tailwind CSS
- Data Privacy: 100% client-side processing, no data leaves the browser.
- External dependencies: Monaco Editor for advanced code editing views.

For further information, please visit the specific tool pages on https://www.allformatter.com.
